Commentary.Commentary: It could be the innings from Perera that would have convinced the Indians that they should bat since the deck is still a pretty good one. The bowlers weren't at their best but got the work done at the end. Ravindra Jadeja was the pick of the bowlers. Ravichandran Ashwin bowled well yesterday but didn't get the same bite today. India get a lead of 309 runs and will look to bat Sri Lanka out of the game completely. Join us in a while for their innings.

India have not enforced the follow-on, they WILL BAT again. A very good effort from them on what has been a reasonably good wicket to bat. The pacer Mohammed Shami set it up with two quick wickets early on. Upul Tharanga and Angelo Mathews fought hard scoring fifties but the Indian spinners kept troubling them all the time. Dilruwan Perera stayed unbeaten on 92 and will rue on missing out a ton since he was batting and playing his shots really well.

OUT! Jadeja finishes things off! Lands it just outside off, spins in, Kumara plays down the wrong line and is bowled. SRI LANKA BOWLED OUT FOR 291! India have gained their highest first innings lead in a Test in Sri Lanka - 309!
In line of the stumps, Lahiru defends it watchfully.
Floats it around off, Kumara comes forward and defends it.
The sun has peeked out. Ravindra Jadeja to bowl from the other end.

Length ball outside off, Perera taps it towards point and takes off. Mukund has a shy at the striker's end from covers but fails to hit. They take an extra on the overthrow. Had he hit, that would have been a wicket.

The groundstaff is getting ready.
Good length around off, punched towards mid on from his crease.

The players are out in the middle. The two batsmen, Dilruwan Perera and Lahiru Kumara to bat. India will want to take the final wicket quickly. They begin with Hardik Pandya! Wonder why the umpires took lunch since there is no Gunaratne to bat. Cricket at times, befuddles you. Let's see how they go and if they enforce the follow-on.
.... Day 3, Session 2 ....

None of the bowlers except Ravindra Jadeja were effective as they hardly troubled the batsmen in the middle. It would be interesting to see how long the hosts last though. Will Virat Kohli impose the follow-on or will he bat again? That seems to be the thing which would be on everyone's mind. Join us in a while for the post-lunch session.

Sri Lanka have managed to survive the session and they have also scored 135 runs in the process. Angelo Mathews and Dilruwan Perera started off the day in a really comforting manner. Both of them looked settled in the first hour but a rather rash shot from the former broke the stand. Dilruwan kept on playing his shots from the other end and is closing in on his maiden ton.

Play time! Angelo Mathews and Dilruwan Perera come out to battle it out. India will aim for quick wickets. India begin with Umesh Yadav! Two slips in place for him. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold doing the pitch report observes that the behavior of the pitch is changing. Reckons that yesterday was a fantastic day of cricket where a lot of runs were scored and also wickets kept on falling. Mentions that the deck will dry up and the spinners are going to get a lot of purchase from the track today. Adds that Ashwin was effective because he was giving the ball much more air compared to the Lankan bowlers. He spots two areas on the deck from where the ball is likely to misbehave - one will help the ball turn, the other which is lot closer to the stumps might make the ball skid on. Plenty of help for the spinners. Tough work for the batsmen expected.

The tourists lost the first Test at Galle in 2015 from a similar position. They were chasing a paltry total after getting a huge lead but it was Rangana's Herath magic that did them in. They will be aware that the deck at Galle has a history of breaking down quickly and hence might want to bat again and leave nothing to chance. The Islanders have a tough task on hand, let's see how they go.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day 3 of the first Test between Sri Lanka and India in Galle. The visitors have got the hosts on the mat at the moment. After scoring 600, they have reduced the home side to effectively 154 for 6, with no Asela Gunaratne. With only Angelo Mathews left as the last recognized batsman, they will want to try and avoid the follow-on. Not sure if India will enforce it though.
.... Day 3, Session 1 ....

Angelo Mathews is once again doing what he can do best, fighting. He has scored a fifty but only has the tail to follow with no Asela Gunaratne. They are still a long way behind in this Test. It is going to need something really special from them to bounce back. India will be happy with their efforts. They will aim to continue the good work and set the game up for them. We look forward to your company for all the action on Day 3 at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

India finish Day 2 in firm control of this Test! They scored 201 runs earlier in the day with Hardik Pandya scoring a fifty to back up the good work by the top order. Mohammed Shami then struck twice with the new ball to peg the Lankans back. Upul Tharanga though, played his shots at will and got to his fifty but his innings was cut short by a bizarre run out. Niroshan Dickwella did not last long either. Ravichandran Ashwin bowled a really good spell. They can actually credit the last two wickets to brilliant fielding by Abhinav Mukund who was very proactive in the close-in position.

Quicker around leg, Mathews defends it back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, Dickwella sweeps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Mathews prods forward and defends it.
Tossed up around off, punched towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller around off, Dickwella dances down the track and eases it towards long on for a single to get off the mark.
Shortish outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Floated fuller outside off, Mathews drives it back to the bowler.
Niroshan Dickwella strides out to bat. Sri Lanka still trail by 475 runs.

OUT! Smart fielding, Mukund! Floated around middle and leg, Tharanga dances down the track and looks to drive. He gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball deflects towards silly point. Mukund the fielder is quick to throw it back to the keeper. Upul dives to get into his crease and at the same time Saha takes off the bails and appeals. The umpire goes upstairs this time. Replays show that Tharanga had made it in but his bat bounced up due to the impact on the handle as he dived. Strangely, the batsman was confident at first but now he has to walk back to the hut. A brilliant knock from the opener comes to an end.
A run out appeal is referred upstairs against Tharanga. Looks close!
Around middle and leg, swept towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Quicker around off, Tharanga camps back and cuts it through the point region for a single.
Floated outside off, Tharanga leans into the ball and blocks it towards silly point.
Outside off, Tharanga camps back and punches it towards covers.
Tossed up around off, Upul Tharanga gets forward and plays the paddle scoop through the backward square leg region for a couple.
Floats this one outside off, Mathews gets to the pitch of the ball to defend.
Angelo gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
50-run stand between Mathews and Tharanga.
FOUR! A bit short and wide outside off, Mathews camps back and chops it through the point region for a boundary. Good shot, this!

Huge shout for LBW! Quicker into the pads, the ball hurries into the batsman after pitching. Mathews fails to clip it through and gets rapped high on his pads. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Tossed up around off, Angelo dances down the track and blocks it away.
Quicker around off, Mathews stays in his crease and defends.
Tharanga stays deep in his crease and defends it well.
Driven towards the mid off region.

Good work! Tharanga prods forward and pushes it towards silly point. Abhinav Mukund stops the ball and has a shy at the striker's end. Upul realises that quickly and dives in to make it back in the crease.
Upul is forward to defend but gets an outside edge through slips.
Quicker around off, Tharanga adjusts at the last moment and defends it.
Tharanga stays deep in his crease and punches it towards the fielder at mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around off, Tharanga looks to defend. Gets an inside edge past short leg for a single.
Shout for LBW! Floated outside off, Upul shuffles across and tries to defend. Misses it and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the batsman was way across.
Quicker around off, Tharanga reaches out to it and drives it towards mid off.
Mathews shuffles a bit across and plays a predetermined sweep through backward square leg for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tharanga comes to the pitch of the ball and drives it back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, Tharanga stays back and chops it towards gully.
Mathews comes down the track and drives it towards long on for a single.
OUCH! Tosses this one around leg, Mathews goes for the reverse sweep. Gets a top edge on it and the ball goes on to hit his helmet.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Angelo lunges forward to defend.
Quicker in line of the stumps, Mathews clips it towards mid-wicket.
Again down the leg side this time, Tharanga misses his clip and gets rapped on the pads.
Tharanga gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it well.
Quicker into the pads, Tharanga gets it off the inner half towards leg slip. Kohli makes a good stop.
Shortish outside off, Tharanga cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Around off again, Tharanga defends it well.
Leg slip in place now.
Fires it down the leg side, Tharanga fails to clip it through. The keeper fails to collect it neatly.
Angelo gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Mathews sweeps it on the leg side.

NOT OUT! Mathews survives! Tossed up outside off, spinning in. Mathews tries to nudge it on the leg side. Fails to read it well and gets rapped on the pads. The players are confident and they start appealing. The umpire stays unmoved. Kohli consults his players and opts for the review. Replays show that there was no bat involved. Ball Tracker informs that it was pitched in line, impact was also in line and the ball was going on to clip the top of off stump. That means the umpire's call stays. Unlucky there, Ashwin.
Indians are confident for an lbw appeal against Mathews and have gone for a review. Looks close.
Around off, Tharanga punches it through covers for a single.
Tharanga lunges forward and defends it neatly.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Mathews gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it well.
Leg bye! Brilliant ball! Floated outside off, spinning in. Tharanga leans forward to defend. Gets beaten, it brushes the pads and the ball goes past the keeper. The batsmen run a leg bye.
Quicker around off, Tharanga gets forward to defend.
Mathews stays in his crease and drives it through silly point. The covers fielder cuts it off. Single taken.
Floated around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Floated on off, Mathews prods forward in defence. Gets an inside edge to the pads.
Ravindra Jadeja is introduced into the attack.
Drinks! The pair of Mathews and Tharanga has steadied Sri Lanka after the two quick wickets. There is lot more work to be done though.

This one is bowled just around off, Tharanga goes back to punch that one but the ball spins and bounces to beat the batsman. Ashwin is bowling really well here, looks to be in full control. Brilliant over!
Floats it around middle, Tharanga comes forward and pushes it with hard hands off the splice towards the vacant silly point region.
Slower, shorter in length, Upul goes back and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Floats it around off, Tharanga comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Shorter outside off, flayed through point for a brace.
Floats it around middle, Tharanga comes down and defends it.
SIX! Top edged! Shorter in length around middle, Mathew swivels a touch and just plays a short arm jab. The ball flies off the top edge and settles over the long leg fence.
FOUR! Lovely hit! Full and outside off, Mathews stands tall and hits it on the up through covers for a boundary.
Good length outside off, Mathews stays back and defends it.
Full and straight around off, pushed towards mid on from Mathews.
Honing around off, slight reverse on offer, Mathews clips it towards the leg side.
Fuller around off, clipped towards mid on from his crease.
Tharanga stays in his crease and defends it.
Another flat ball down the leg side, Mathews comes down and spots that he is not close to the ball. Heaves it through long leg for a single.
Flatter around middle expecting a charge, Mathews stays back and defends it.
Fuller outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Well bowled! Loops it around off, Tharanga comes forward to defend but is beaten by the sharp turn. Lovely ball, that.
Flatter on middle and leg, Tharanga tucks it towards short leg.
Angles it on a length, nudged towards the leg side.
Angles it around middle and leg, worked through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Good length outside off, Mathews punches it towards covers.
FOUR! Crunched! Short and wide outside off, Mathews stands tall and punches it through covers for a boundary. That was superbly hit.
Good length outside off, punched towards mid off from his crease.
Lands it around leg, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Umesh Yadav returns for a bowl.
Mathews stays back to this tossed up delivery around leg. Flicks it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Sloppy work! A tad short outside off, Mathews punches it towards mid off. Umesh is late to bend down and goes through his legs for a boundary. Ashwin does not like that.
Mathews turns it towards the leg side from his crease.
CLOSE! Drifts it around middle, straightens, Mathews comes down a touch to defend but is hit on his pads. An appeal for lbw is turned down. Replays show it was a bit high.
Shorter around off, Mathews defends it off the inner half towards short leg. He has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Floats it around off, Mathews comes forward and defends it.
Good length around off, Tharanga defends it towards mid on.
Good length around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Punches it towards mid on from his crease.
FOUR! Dispatched! Another short one, Angelo Mathews gets behind it and pummels it through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was hit with a lot of intent.
Is that out? Shorter in length around the stumps, Mathews shapes to pull but misses. Stifled appeal turned down.
Full and outside off, dug out by Mathews back to the bowler.
Upul stays in line and defends it.
Tharanga prods forward and defends it.
Stays back and defends this one watchfully.
Shout but not given! Floats it around off, Tharanga comes down and pads it away. Mild appeal turned down.
Edged! Another leading edge for Mathews. Tharanga calls him through for a quick single.
Lands it around leg, Mathews shapes to clip but gets a soft leading edge towards covers.
Short ball around off, Tharanga pulls it wide of mid on for a couple of runs.
Shorter outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Full outside off, pushed off the face of the bat wide of point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Mathews defends it.
Shortish outside off, Mathews punches it towards point and finds Jadeja. Mathews reckons he missed out on two boundaries.
Short and wide outside off, cut towards point by the batsman.
Shorter in length outside off, Mathews lets it go through. Wide signaled for the height on that one.
On the pads, turned towards fine leg for a single. He gets off the mark at last.
Mathews looks to get across and punch but mistimes it back down the wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Mathews comes forward and pushes it towards point.
Floats it around off, Mathews comes forward and defends it.
Drifts it around off, Tharanga shapes to defend but gets an inside edge through the legs of the short leg fielder for a single.
Flatter around off, Tharanga works it towards the leg side off his back foot.
Shorter outside off, Mathews toe ends his pull shot towards mid on.
Good length around off, tucked towards the leg side.
Rohit Sharma is on the field for Umesh Yadav.
Good length around off, Mathews stays back and defends it.
Back of a length outside off, Mathews stays back and pushes it towards point.
Mathews defends it watchfully from his crease.
Fuller around off, Mathews gets in line and defends it.
Comes forward and defends it.
Tharanga gets in line and defends it.
8th Test fifty for Upul Tharanga!

FOUR! Fifty for Tharanga! Floats it outside off, Upul drives it through covers for a boundary. Mukund in the deep made a mess of it. This has been a very good knock from the southpaw. It is the fifth fastest fifty for a Sri Lankan.
Fuller outside off, driven towards point from his crease.
Lands it around off, Tharanga defends it watchfully.
Floats it around off, Tharanga comes forward and defends it.
Angelo Mathews comes out to bat with his side in trouble.

OUT! Easy as you like! Good length outside off, Mendis looks to poke at this one. The ball goes off the outside edge and Shikhar Dhawan takes another good catch at first slip. Shami has taken two in two and Sri Lanka are in real trouble now.
Good length around off, Mendis defends it from his crease.
Third slip in place now.
Back of a length outside off, Mendis is happy to let it go.
Good length outside off, left alone by Mendis.
Kusal Mendis walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! Very poor shot! Slants a good length ball outside off, Gunathilaka looks to flay it away but gets an outside edge towards first slip. Shikhar Dhawan accepts the gift but one wonders if the batsman needs to play such shots. A poor shot indeed with your team trailing by 532 runs. Remember they are a batsman short with no Asela Gunaratne.
Back of a length around off, Gunathilaka chops it from his crease trying to cut.
Mohammed Shami returns for a bowl.
Floats it around off and middle, Tharanga defends it watchfully.
A gully is in place now.
FOUR! Flashy! Shorter outside off, Tharanga shapes to cut but gets an edge past the first slip fielder for a boundary. Ashwin is bowling well. Maybe Kohli needs to attack a bit more?
Flatter this time, a tad, Tharanga stays back and defends it.
A tad quicker around middle, Tharanga lunges forward and defends it.
Loops it around middle, Upul comes forward and defends it.
Floats it around off, Tharanga gets it off the inner half towards mid on. Ashwin is getting good drift.
Good length around off, Danushka defends it watchfully.
Shorter in length but down the leg side, Gunathilaka ducks under it.
Fuller outside off, Gunathilaka mistimes it back towards mid off.
Tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Full and outside off, Tharanga comes forward and creams it through covers for a boundary. He has got off to a flier.
50-run stand between Upul Tharanga and Danushka Gunathilaka.

FOUR! Nobody went for it! Shortish outside off, Tharanga goes hard at it. The ball takes the edge and flies between the keeper and the wide first slip fielder for a boundary to third man. Neither Shikhar Dhawan nor the keeper went for it. Simon Doull can't understand why there is no orthodox slip.
Goes straight on, with the loop, Gunathilaka comes forward and blocks it.
Loops it around off and middle, spins away, Gunathilaka reacts well and defends it.
Bowls it outside off, spins in a tad, Gunathilaka leaves it all alone.
Lands it outside off, Gunathilaka comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Shorter around off, punched wide of Jadeja at point. An off-balance throw at the bowler's end allows the batsmen a couple.
Floats it around off, Gunathilaka comes forward and defends it.
Tucks it down towards fine leg. Pandya covers good ground to his left and keeps the ball in play. Two runs taken.
Bouncer! Shorter in length, Upul ducks.

CHANCE! Length around off, Tharanga works it towards mid on and wants a single but is sent back. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Had he hit, that would have been out. Pujara was a tad slow to react to it.
Fuller around off, worked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. The runs are have come fairly easily. 50 up for Sri Lanka.
Good length around off, pushed towards covers from his crease.
Full and on the stumps, Gunathilaka brings his bat down just in time to get it through his legs. He falls over but has protected his stumps there.
Tharanga lunges forward and defends it.
Flights it outside off, Tharanga lets it go through.
FOUR! Hit away! Drops it short again wide outside off, Tharanga cuts it behind point for a boundary.
Shorter around off, punched to covers by the batsman.
Drifts it around middle, nudged towards backward square leg for a single.
Shorter outside off, punched to cover by Gunathilaka.
Good length but down the leg side, the batsman cannot clip it through.
Good length outside off, punched towards covers.
Shorter in length on middle, Tharanga ducks under it.
On the pads, Gunathilaka fails to clip it through. The ball goes off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye signaled.
Fullish around off, Gunathilaka comes forward and defends it.
Shorter in length around the leg stump, fended towards backward square leg for a single. Leg byes signaled.
Umesh Yadav to bowl from the other end.
Drifts it around middle and leg, Gunathilaka defends it watchfully.
Loops it around off, Gunathilaka comes forward and defends it.
Flatter around off, Tharanga shapes to defend but gets an inside edge towards the leg side for a single. Purchase for Ashwin already!
Lunges forward and pushes it towards covers.
Loops it outside off, Tharanga comes forward and looks to defend but gets an outside edge wide of first slip. Two runs taken.
Floats it around off, turns in,  Tharanga punches it towards the off side.
The players return for the final session of play. Upul Tharanga and Danushka Gunathilaka come out to bat. Ravichandran Ashwin has been handed the ball.
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

A good start from Sri Lanka. Upul Tharanga and Danushka Gunathilaka have looked comfortable in the middle despite losing Dimuth Karunaratne early. Umesh Yadav and Mohammed Shami have not hit the straps perfectly except a brilliant over where the former managed to pick up a wicket. Earlier in the session, debutant Hardik Pandya played a breezy knock to take India to 600. An interesting session of play awaits after Tea.
Around off, Gunathilaka gets forward and defends it on the leg side. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 2.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Danushka defends it back to the bowler.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Around a shortish delivery outside off, Upul Tharanga slashes hard at it. Flashes it over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery angling into the batsman, Tharanga tries to nudge it on the leg side. Fails to make contact and gets hit on the body.
Angling into the batsman, Gunathilaka clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Best of the lot! Fuller delivery outside off, Upul Tharanga leans into the drive and plays it crisply through the extra cover region for a boundary.
Good length delivery around off, Upul glides it towards the fielder at gully.
Deep point is in place now.
FOUR! Sweet! Good length delivery outside off, Tharanga presses forward and punches it through the cover region for a boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! Back of a length delivery outside off, Upul Tharanga stands tall, hops a bit and crashes it over the backward point region for a boundary.
Short delivery into the batsman, Tharanga ducks underneath it.
Good length delivery outside off, Tharanga flashes at it but fails to make contact.
FOUR! Good shot! Good length delivery around off, Gunathilaka stands tall and plays a punch through the cover region for a boundary.
Mohammed Shami now comes over the wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Back of a length delivery down the leg side, Gunathilaka nudges it through the backward square leg region for a couple. The umpire is not happy with Mohammed Shami's followthrough. He has a word with him regarding that.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler by the batsman.
Length delivery around off, Danushka Gunathilaka stands tall and defends it well.
FOUR! Good length delivery around off, nipping away. Gunathilaka stands tall and punches it through the cover region for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, glanced towards backward square leg for a single. He gets off the mark in style.
Simon Doull spots that Tharanga was standing way wide on the crease when Karunaratne was given out lbw. He could not have judged the line of the ball well from that angle.
Full length delivery outside off, Danushka tries to defend in line of the ball but he gets beaten all ends up.
Another good length delivery around off this time, Gunathilaka camps back and defends it towards covers.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Top stuff! Back of a length delivery around off, Gunathilaka hangs his bat in defence but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Short delivery around off, Tharanga guides it towards backward point and calls for a single. Jadeja cuts it across and has a shy at the striker's end but he misses.
Full length delivery around off, Danushka drives it back to the bowler. Shami has a wild throw at the striker's end.
Good length delivery around off, nipping away. Gunathilaka covers his stumps and lets the ball through.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Danushka stays tall and defends it to the left of the bowler.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Gunathilaka goes after it but he fails to make contact.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Upul nudges it towards the fine leg fielder for a single.
Length delivery around middle and leg, Tharanga clips it towards the fielder at square leg.
Fuller delivery around off, nipping back in, Gunathilaka defends it back to the bowler.
Debutant Danushka Gunathilaka comes out to bat at number three.

OUT! Umesh, you beauty! Fires a fuller delivery around middle, nips back in after pitching. Karunaratne tries to clip it on the leg side but gets beaten for pace. Misses it completely and the ball sneaks through and thuds into the pads. The players appeal and the umpire takes his time to raise the finger. Upul Tharanga convinces his partner to opt for the review for some reason. Replays show that there was no bat involved. Ball Tracker indicates that it pitched in line, impact was in line and was clearly hitting the stumps. No doubt at all and the opener has to walk back to the hut. Umesh Yadav has struck early. Sri Lanka have also wasted a review.
Umesh Yadav traps Karunaratne in front of the stumps but Tharanga convinces his partner to go for the review. Looks like a desperate one.
Another shortish delivery angling into the batsman, Karunaratne nudges it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
No third slip now.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Karunaratne looks to push but edges it towards the fielder at third slip.
Angling in from a good length around off, Tharanga clips it towards backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Tharanga gets off the mark! Good length delivery outside off, nips back in. Upul adjusts well and guides it through the point region for a boundary.
Umesh Yadav will share the new ball.
Length delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery around off, nipping away. Karunaratne tries to defend it. Gets it off the outer half through the backward point region for a couple. First runs on the board.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Karunaratne stays tall and defends it well.
Karunaratne stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Just short! On a good length around off, nipping in. Karunaratne tries to defend. Gets an outside edge to it and the ball falls short of the fielder at third slip.
Starts off with a wayward line, bowls this short and wide down the leg side. The batsman is not interested.
